narrative.introduction: This domain covers culinary sweeteners, syrups, honey products, natural and alternative sweeteners, and cocoa or chocolate ingredients used worldwide in cooking — organized around how they're used in the kitchen, not desserts, confectionery, beverages, recipes, or commercial brands.
narrative.seo_description: Culinary sweeteners across six groups: Sugars, Syrups, Honey & Bee Products, Natural Sweeteners, Alternative Sweeteners, and Cocoa & Chocolate Ingredients.
narrative.summary: Culinary sweeteners across six groups: Sugars, Syrups, Honey & Bee Products, Natural Sweeteners, Alternative Sweeteners, and Cocoa & Chocolate Ingredients.
